summary.headline: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue rose 19.2% YoY to INR1,616 crore, but EBITDA was flat at INR188.9 crore as margin fell to 11.7% from 13.8%.
summary.overview: Consolidated income from operations rose about 19.2% YoY to INR1,616 crore, while reported EBITDA was broadly flat at INR188.9 crore, and PBT fell about 1.4% to INR130.03 crore. Guinea bauxite volumes were 2.34 million tons, down from 3.16 million tons in Q4 and up from 2.05 million tons a year earlier, with bauxite EBITDA per ton at USD6.3 versus USD5.9 in Q4. Higher ocean freight, fuel costs and input costs (notably sulphuric acid for bleaching clay) compressed margins, and management guided that EBITDA per ton would stay near current levels until freight eases or a Guinea export quota system is implemented, which it expects before end-2026.

financial_highlights.change: vs 3.16 mt in Q4 and 2.05 mt in Q1 FY26

segments.name: Guinea bauxite and iron ore
segments.commentary: Turnover about INR1,360 crore (84% of consolidated) and EBITDA INR163 crore; bauxite volume 2.34 mt. Iron ore is in trial production with revenue not disclosed and EBITDA reported as bauxite-only.

segments.name: India - Bentonite and allied minerals / white performance minerals
segments.commentary: Bentonite broadly stable with top-line close to prior year as exports hit by freight and domestic growth offset; white performance minerals performing well but profitability hit by higher sales and distribution expenses.

segments.name: India - Bleaching clay (50% JV Ashapura Perfoclay)
segments.commentary: Significant cost pressure as sulphuric acid prices rose about five-fold over the past year to above INR30/kg.

segments.name: India - Advanced ceramics (32% in Orient Ceratech)
segments.commentary: Encouraging profitability growth on premium product mix; management said Orient's segment EBITDA has more than doubled, driven by oil and gas and steel-industry materials.

guidance_outlook: Full-year bauxite volume target of 10-12 million tons retained with a possible ±10% variance (9-11 mt range); Q2 is seasonally weakest, with stronger sales expected in late Q3 and Q4.
Iron ore: 15 million tons target by FY28 maintained, with management saying it is on track to achieve or exceed; commercialisation still needs a couple of quarters.
Bauxite EBITDA per ton expected around USD5.5-6 in the next one to two quarters; management sees a return toward USD10/t over the medium to longer term, timing uncertain.
Management expects EBITDA to improve significantly in the next calendar year if freight normalises and a Guinea quota system takes effect.
Medium-term aim for more than half, or most, of group EBITDA to come from value-added products within about three years.
India capex of about INR200 crore planned across projects; bauxite washing plant (20,000 tpd) is an operate-and-transfer model with about USD15 million cost if installed elsewhere.
capex_capacity: Boffa port capacity enhanced from 5 mtpa to 8 mtpa and now fully operational; current bauxite export capacity stated at 18 mt.
GSM second port new jetty under construction, expected operational by Q4 FY27, lifting capacity from 6 mtpa to 10 mtpa; combined port capacity about 23 mt.
Further Boffa expansion to 10-12 mt has no significant timeline and will depend on volume ramp-up.
Bauxite washing plant set up with capacity about 20,000 tons per day; expansion would take about one year if decided.
Fako bauxite deposit (about 230 mt, China Railway MOU) still in study stage; no material progress expected until about next year.
Bentonite grinding capacity over 1 million tons, described as the world's largest within the group.
demand_pricing: Chinese bauxite index around USD72/t, up from about USD61, which management attributes mainly to higher ocean freight rather than FOB Guinea price.
Alumina prices under pressure; management expects China inventories to normalise and market prices to improve gradually over coming quarters.
Four new Chinese refineries expected to add 20-30 mt of incremental bauxite demand over current volumes.
Freight remains very elevated as a share of CIF cost with limited vessel availability; management expects volatility to persist through 2027.
Middle East and Europe customer demand hit by geopolitics and freight; India, Asia and Africa markets being prioritised.

qa_highlights.question: When will the Guinea bauxite quota system take effect and how will realisations move?
qa_highlights.answer: Management expects it before end-2026 but is still awaiting government detail; realisations are expected to stay similar until the quota system brings a directional tailwind, and freight remains an overhang.

qa_highlights.question: Is the 15 mt iron ore target by FY28 on track?
qa_highlights.answer: Yes, management said absolutely on track.

qa_highlights.question: Quantify bauxite EBITDA per ton outlook for FY27 and FY28.
qa_highlights.answer: Management expects around USD6 or USD5.5-6 in the next one to two quarters, with a recovery toward about USD10/t as a normal run rate over the medium to longer term, timing uncertain.

qa_highlights.question: Will the bauxite washing plant lift EBITDA?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the plant is largely EBITDA-neutral and is aimed at sustaining volumes and quality; no EBITDA quantification was given. Washery investment is about USD15 million on an operate-and-transfer model, off balance sheet.

qa_highlights.question: What is the outlook for the 10-12 mt volume target given Q1 volume of 2.34 mt?
qa_highlights.answer: Q2 is seasonally weak; the company is prioritising profitability over volume while freight is high, and sees a 9-11 mt range as possible with stronger Q3 and Q4.

qa_highlights.question: Will Boffa port expand beyond 8 mt to reach 10 mt in Q2?
qa_highlights.answer: No near-term plan; 8 mt is seen as reasonable for the short term, with expansion to 10-12 mt to follow volume ramp-up without a fixed timeline.

qa_highlights.question: What is driving the sharp rise in Orient Ceratech's contribution?
qa_highlights.answer: Higher oil and gas demand with debottlenecking, and steel-industry materials that replace international suppliers, plus some recovery in traditional ceramic raw materials.

risks_watch: Ocean freight and vessel availability: elevated freight is the main near-term margin overhang and the quarter's EBITDA drag.
Timing and detail of the Guinea export quota system, which is central to management's price and margin recovery thesis.
Sulphuric acid cost (about five-fold YoY, above INR30/kg) pressuring bleaching clay margins.
Volume shortfall risk versus the 10-12 mt FY27 bauxite target after 2.34 mt in Q1; management's acknowledged range is 9-11 mt.
Iron ore remains in trial with undisclosed revenue; no long-term guidance until a couple of quarters from now.
Competitive entry by other Guinea exporters (e.g. Nimba tender sales) and the possibility of Ashapura participating in tenders.
summary.management_tone: Cautious but confident on the long term: management acknowledged short-term margin pressure from freight, fuel and input costs and gave no near-term EBITDA upgrade, while repeatedly stressing that volumes and targets remain achievable. Answers on the washery benefit, iron ore revenue and Fako timing were vague or deferred, and the India value-added pipeline was described qualitatively with no numbers.
key_quotes: So, we expect EBITDA to improve significantly from now, maybe in the sort of next calendar year, at least this is our expectation.
The EBITDA which we have shared in our releases is strictly belonging to the bauxite business.
So washery investment will not be reflecting on our balance sheet as it's on a kind of operate and transfer kind of model.

growth.why: No explicit revenue growth guidance; FY27 bauxite volume held at 9-11 Mt (vs 10-12 Mt target), with GSM second jetty (6 to 10 mtpa) due in Q4 FY27 and Boffa at 8 mtpa, but EBITDA per ton guided to USD5.5-6 for the next 1-2 quarters due to freight and quota uncertainty.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Bauxite EBITDA/t at USD6.3 in Q1 vs USD5.9 in Q4, but management guides USD5.5-6/t for the next 1-2 quarters and a recovery toward USD10/t only over the medium to longer term; EBITDA margin fell to 11.7% from 13.8%.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: GSM second port jetty under construction, lifting capacity from 6 to 10 mtpa, expected operational by Q4 FY27; Boffa already raised to 8 mtpa and fully operational.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Q1 bauxite volume 2.34 mt (up from 2.05 mt YoY) and FY27 target held at 9-11 mt implied versus 10-12 mt; Q2 seasonally weakest, stronger sales expected late Q3 and Q4, but company prioritising profitability over volume.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Planned India capex of about INR200 crore across projects and a bauxite washery (20,000 tpd, operate-and-transfer, ~USD15m) are in planning, but no firm dates and utilisation is not discussed; Boffa 10-12 mt expansion has no timeline.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Management gave no near-term EBITDA upgrade; freight and fuel are compressing margins and the volume target was trimmed to an implied 9-11 mt range.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: FY27 bauxite volume range of 9-11 mt sits below the original 10-12 mt, with Q1 at 2.34 mt; freight and sulphuric acid (about five-fold YoY, above INR30/kg) remain overhangs.

rows.label: Guinea export quota system before end-2026
rows.why: Management expects the Guinea quota system before end-2026 and sees it as a directional tailwind to realisations, though government detail is still awaited and freight remains an overhang.

rows.label: Iron ore commercialisation to 15 Mt by FY28
rows.when: FY28; commercial sales in a couple of quarters
rows.why: Iron ore is in trial production and management says it is on track to achieve or exceed 15 Mt by FY28, but revenue is not yet disclosed and commercialisation needs a couple of quarters.

rows.label: Orient Ceratech advanced ceramics ramp
rows.why: Orient's segment EBITDA has more than doubled on oil and gas and steel-industry demand with debottlenecking; the 32% stake is a continuing contributor.

tone.note: Management was confident on the long-term iron ore target, Boffa capacity and the Guinea quota, but cautious on near-term margins from freight, fuel and sulphuric acid; the washery benefit, iron ore revenue and Fako timing were vague.
